topic: What does a standard day ticket for Alton Towers cost?

text: Does anyone know roughly what a standard day ticket for alton towers costs now 👀 asking for the weekend thing
No idea sorry, I'd check the site rather than guess. Are we actually doing alton or is it just an idea
Ngl I'd rather a cabin tbh. Got one in ashbourne that sleeps 6
[link: cabin in Ashbourne, sleeps 6]
Cabin looks nice!! Alton was just me being nosy
Sorry was on a late, cabin looks good. Who's driving
Me if we're doing the cabin. Jess you still owe me a lift from the last one 😂
I do not 🙄

12th for me. 5th I'm on

Ok 12th then. Jess shout when you know
Yeah 12th is fine 👍
Is there a hot tub on the listing or am I imagining it
There is 😂 check the pics
Oh good
Do we need to bring food or is there a shop nearby
Shop in the village, just about. Would still bring a big shop, the village one shuts at 6
Home. Cat has knocked a mug off the side again
Tom is it 2 nights or 3
2 I think. Checkin fri
Sorry was mid build, test suite is being awful
Going to bed, 5am start tomorrow. Night
Morning. Test suite finally green, dont ask how

Just got off. Rota's sorted, I'm definitely off the 12th 🎉

Late shift today so I'll be quiet in here till tomorrow. Pharmacy queue is mental

Looks cold. Like properly cold
